canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Lowtowns' chapter of the book of lore, its lines the game's; the Lowtowns, the Rust Market, the Rusty Spoon, the Iron Teeth, the Weave-Eaters and the Chemical River are CANON (world_bible.md; book1 ch.1, 3, 7, 15-16, 20), as each line says.

entries.subject: The Gate Ward
entries.more: The reeve before Edda Holt stopped writing the warrants into the book, and hid the last page she did write in the wall.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Holding House
entries.more: The warders' orders: hold a child one night, give it up at first light, ask nothing. One warder wrote on the back that he asked.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Council's hired men; GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Rusty Spoon
entries.more: Mother Sall's slate of debts has a column for broken chairs, and the column has run off the slate and onto the wall.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Rusty Spoon (book1 ch.1:9); the slate GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Tenement Rows
entries.more: Every child in the Rows learns Rule One before their letters, and somebody keeps chalking it under the bridge.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: Rule One of the Lowtowns (book1 ch.1:257)

entries.subject: The Soup-Hall
entries.more: Brother Aldo's slate counts who ate. Gytha's girl had a second bowl for her hands, which were cold, and bright.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Rust Market
entries.more: The price-board by the long stalls has every price crossed out and written higher, and EVERYTHING DEARER in soot across the bottom.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Rust Market's skewered rat and aether-spiced wine (book1 ch.3:7); the board GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Shard-Burners' Yard
entries.more: The burners' tally: names, dates and nights of light bought. Osric's rule at the bottom: never sell a family its own shard twice.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY reading (the shards as burned memory)

entries.subject: The Drain Courts
entries.more: The militia held the tanners' court a whole winter and cut the nights into the brick.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the former Lowtown militia (book1 ch.20:127); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Docks
entries.more: The dockers keep a lamp lit in a niche on the riverside walk, a copper in the dish for the river. It is for no god; it is for the lamp.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Chemical River
entries.line: Black, slow, iridescent and poisonous. Nothing natural lives in it. The barges go through it anyway, poled by people who try not to splash.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Chemical River (book1 ch.15-16)

entries.subject: The Outfall
entries.line: The Forge District's drain under the wall, grated and signed. Past the grating the culvert turns and goes down, and a warm breath comes up it.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the Sludge-Tunnels, DUNGEON_DESIGN.md)

entries.subject: Old Wulf
entries.more: The militia's last roll is cut into the brick by the well: twenty-two names, nineteen struck through, and Wulf's with room after it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the former Lowtown militia (book1 ch.20:127); Wulf GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Ketta Rune
entries.more: Her grandmother's count, knotted in amber cloth: forty-one Eaters pinned, and three more in Ketta's hand. Bone holds. Steel lies.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: bone harpoons on amber rope (book1 ch.20:177-191); Ketta GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Rudd Crake
entries.more: One of Rudd's gang went into the far courts with a twist of salt to find what took his sister, and lies there yet, the salt in his fist.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Weave-Eaters and salt (book1 ch.20); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Ebba Strand
entries.more: On her days off Ebba walks to the top of the town where the smog thins, to look at the Crown. Just to look.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Crown, white stone and gold (world_bible.md Geography); Ebba GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Mabb Soot
entries.more: Grey-bell grows only in the cinders the burners tip out. Mabb won't pick it. She says it remembers.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Gorm Rock-Wall
entries.line: An orc of the Lowtowns, built like a wall and about as easy to move. He drinks at the Spoon and stops fights there; he dreams of a pier in the north where the water runs clear.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: Gorm Rock-Wall, an orc of the Lowtowns (book1 ch.1:21); his dream of a pier is CANON (book1 ch.1:153)

entries.subject: Gytha Pell
entries.line: A mother in the Rows whose girl, Ysa, sparked over the washing and was taken up by warrant. She stands on her step every day.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Gutter-hound
entries.line: Feral dogs of the back yards, bred from the strays of a hundred years. They run in packs and they are always hungry.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Dock-rat cutter
entries.line: River thieves who work the barges at night with short knives, cutting bales loose and purses too.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Dock-rat poler
entries.line: The dock-rats' polers: they keep the stolen barges moving and use the pole on anyone who comes too close.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Weave-Eater
entries.line: Shadowy spirits of the drains, born of the High City's magical waste. Steel that passes through one comes out black and brittle; salt makes it solid; bone holds it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: Weave-Eaters, parasitic spirits born of the High City's magical pollution (book1 ch.1:251); steel through one turns black and brittle (book1 ch.20:155)

entries.subject: Mother of Drains
entries.line: The militia's name for the great Eater under the courts. She comes up only after dark, and the lamps gutter when she does.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Weave-Eaters (book1 ch.1:251); the Mother GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Iron Teeth runner
entries.line: The Iron Teeth's runners keep the back lanes of the market for the gang. Up here they trade. Back there, they don't.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Iron Teeth (B1WB:26; book1 ch.7:21); GAME-ONLY camp

entries.subject: Iron Teeth sifter
entries.line: The Teeth's sifters work the slag that comes out of the Outfall, picking out the bits that glow.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Iron Teeth (B1WB:26; book1 ch.7:21); the sifting GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Knuckle Brannoc
entries.line: The Iron Teeth's yard-boss by the Outfall. Iron on his knuckles, a ledger in his coat, and two sifters always at his back.
entries.canonStatus: CANON faction: the Iron Teeth (book1 ch.7:21); Brannoc GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Hired warder
entries.line: The Council's hired men at the Holding House. They do not read the warrants and they do not ask the children's names.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Council's hired men; GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Grey-touched
entries.line: What is left when a shard is burned wrong: grey, slow, and almost somebody. The burners keep them in the cellar.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the shards as burned memory)

entries.subject: The Lantern-Eater
entries.line: A Weave-Eater that drinks the light out of the lamps of one lane, a lamp a night, the glass frosted black behind it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Weave-Eaters (book1 ch.1:251); the Lantern-Eater GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: node.slagiron
entries.line: Slag-iron: the foundries' cast-offs heaped in the yards of fallen terraces. Hard to work and never clean, but iron.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals

entries.subject: node.cinderbeam
entries.line: Cinder-beams: the old roof timbers of fallen terraces, charred black outside and sound within.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals

entries.subject: node.sootwort
entries.line: Soot-wort grows in the gutters and on the ash heaps where nothing else will. The Lowtowns cough, and soot-wort is for coughs.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals

entries.subject: node.lamp_lichen
entries.line: Lamp-lichen glows by the drains, a dim gold-green. Pick it at night and your hands shine till morning.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals

entries.subject: herb.grey_bell
entries.line: Pale bells with a light in them like a held breath. Rare, and the Lowtowners leave it be.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals
